items.title: The Business Accenture Now Mentions In Passing

items.title: Is Cognizant (CTSH) Quietly Redefining Its Automation Edge With Kyowa Kirin’s AI R&D Deal?
items.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions recently announced it will support Kyowa Kirin in implementing Benchling, an AI-driven R&D platform, at the Tokyo and Fuji Research Parks in Japan, integrating experiment planning, execution, data capture, and AI tools in a single environment. The engagement highlights Cognizant’s role in life sciences digitalization by providing end-to-end AI and automation support, from platform setup and data migration to ongoing maintenance and workflow optimization for...
